title: Worktree Lease v1
description: Per-worktree dispatch contract that constrains a Codex or cheap-Claude worker to a scoped set of paths and test commands. Read by .claude hooks (PreToolUse / PostToolUse) and by the worktree-merge gate to enforce path-glob and test-command boundaries. Sister branch codex-worker-allowedpaths-hook implements the enforcement; this schema defines the wire shape.

schema_version.description: Schema version. v1 mandates this field be the integer 1; future schema bumps will accept higher values via a separate file.

task_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for the task. Used by hooks to correlate diff vs lease, and by the followup-tracker to surface lease violations.

worker.description: Which model (or human) owns the dispatch. Used by the routing skill to bill / cap-track the right vendor.

worktree.description: Absolute filesystem path to the worktree root. Reader validates it exists at lease-read time.

branch.description: Git branch the worker is committing on. Reader optionally cross-checks `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` matches when validate_branch is enabled.

allowed_paths.description: Glob patterns (supporting `*` and `**`) of repository-relative paths the worker may write. Empty array means worker may not write anything.

forbidden_paths.description: Glob patterns the worker must not touch. Takes precedence over allowed_paths when a path matches both.

test_commands.description: Exact-match shell commands the worker is permitted to run via Bash. Anything else is rejected by the test-command-authorization PreToolUse hook (sister branch). Exact match (no glob, no substring) is intentional security-via-simplicity.

merge_authority.description: Reviewer voice authorized to PROCEED the merge. Defaults to the project's torvalds reviewer.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp the lease was issued.

expires_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 soft-expiry timestamp. Readers may report is_expired=true past this point; enforcement policy is up to the consumer.

parent_task_id.description: Optional task_id of the parent dispatch when this lease is a nested sub-dispatch. Out of bring-up scope; reserved field.
